note: hookflat-correct-1124-m1124c (2026-11-24, WRITTEN, NOT RUN; correctness, not timing: run with --no-smoke). Issue #92 / docs/130 §11: m1124c folds the two two-layer hook pairs (PrxRouteHook + BuRouteHook on SimRoutingComponent.DoRoute, RheEnterHook + RabbitHoleHook on RabbitHole.RouteNearEntranceAndEnterRabbitHole) into one hook each and flattens BuRouteHook's failed-plan rule chain (it was 8 nested frames, not recursion). No switch, behaviour unchanged by construction; household exemptions untouched. Order: read-back (stops on FAIL), the two incident games (vbowner delete-stress x3, bp-lc7 save-reload natural play), then the saved-frame arms (docs/242 + docs/293 shape: own save, m1124b save, v0.3.0 RC save, vanilla save, uninstall), each save step before the load that reads it. Scratch saves SgMidRoute (one scratch name, each save step overwrites it right before the load that reads it): delete after the queue. Run the whole queue in order: --only/--from on a load job reads whatever save of that name is on disk. Bin state apex (+ apex-rewind for the rewind group). Do NOT start while chain-m1124b runs.
